Lachlan Giles/Lachlan Giles - K-Guard.overview: Volume 1 of Lachlan Giles' no-gi open guard series (sold as 'No Gi Open Guard Volume 1: K Guard'), eight parts. Part 1 is an overview of his open guard. Part 2 covers the basic game plan. Part 3 introduces the K guard. Part 4 covers entries against a kneeling opponent (the 2-on-1 entry). Part 5 covers entries against combat base. Part 6 covers getting to K guard from guard retention. Part 7 covers offence pathways (K guard to backside 50/50 and others). Part 8 covers troubleshooting (controlling the far leg).
key: K guard entries vs kneeling and combat base

Lachlan Giles/Lachlan Giles - NoGi Open.overview: Volume 2 of Lachlan Giles' no-gi open guard series, eight parts. Parts 1 to 4 cover De La Riva: core concepts, a phased path to the back (getting the angle and onward), troubleshooting when they retreat, and a summary. Part 5 covers moving to the shallow K guard. Parts 6 to 8 cover the waiter guard (getting under a standing opponent): overview, offence (sweeps and leg entries), summary and troubleshooting.
key: No-gi De La Riva to the back

Lachlan Giles/Lachlan Giles - NoGi Open.overview: Volume 3 of Lachlan Giles' no-gi open guard series. Your copy has 7 files; the publisher lists 8 parts. It covers reverse De La Riva (inversion options, summary and troubleshooting), 50/50 and 70/30 (positioning, and 70/30 facing away), single leg X and X guard, and an open guard summary with continuous narrated rolling.

key: Reverse De La Riva and inversions
